text.en:
The Sitio of Bustrac in Barangay La Opinion, Municipality of Nabua, Province of Camarines
Sur, is hereby converted into a distinct and independent barangay of the said municipality, to be known as
Barangay Bustrac.

Barangay Bustrac shall consist of the territory included within the following boundaries:
"From the property between Rufo Refugio and Loreto de los Santos going Westward along a straight line up
to the Eastern boundary by the properties of Lorenzo Parañal and Juliana Llorente, thence going farther
Westward up to a point going to the Northwestern corner up to the property of Marciana Tormes again going
Westward to a point which is the boundary of the properties of Bartolome Quiapo, Benita Parañal and
Lorenzo Parañal, then going Southwestward to a point of the boundary limits between the properties of
Eustaquia Aguila, Primitiva Abanes and Bartolome Quiapo, then going Southward to a point which is the
boundary of the property of Bartolome Quiapo and Cristina Abanes up to the boundary of Bato."
